description.value: The Hedley Heritage Museum is a volunteer-run heritage museum celebrating the gold-rush mining history of Hedley and the Similkameen Valley, featuring a replica miner's cottage, a hospital and school exhibit, vintage mining machinery displayed across the street, and a Miners' Lounge with historical photographs and a family history centre. It doubles as the village's tourist information booth, making it a natural stop for cyclists passing through on Highway 3 (the Crowsnest). The on-site tea room with a shaded veranda and gift shop selling ore samples and local crafts add a pleasant rest-stop dimension.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the museum is located at 712 Daly Avenue, Hedley, BC, and provides a phone number (250-292-8787) not present in OSM. The site prominently advertises a Tea Room serving refreshments and a gift shop, confirming food/drink on site. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null. The museum reopened May 1, 2026, and today is May 25, 2026, so it is currently open.
concerns: OSM name is 'Hedley Museum' but the business operates as 'Hedley Heritage Museum & Tourist Information' — minor name mismatch worth noting.
Two phone numbers appear on the website: 250-292-8787 (main contact listed on contact page and front page) and 250-292-8278 (listed only for off-season tour booking); main number used here.
OSM had no phone number; phone sourced entirely from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate heritage museum and tourist information booth in a small village directly on Highway 3 (Crowsnest cycling route); the tea room makes it a practical rest stop for touring cyclists, and the tourist info function adds directional value.

Café or food on site.detail: Tea Room serves refreshments (tea, coffee, baked goods); guests can sit in the air-conditioned room or on the veranda overlooking the garden. Gift shop also sells items on site

wow_evidence: Volunteer gold-mining museum with replica miner's cottage, doubling as the village info booth; modest heritage stop below the Mascot Mine cliffs.
blurb: Volunteer-run mining museum and info stop in gold-rush Hedley.
